title: Sanctity of the Holy Priesthood
image_prompt: Courtyard of the golden Tabernacle: Aaron's sons dressed in spotless white linen tunics, sashes, and turbans, standing in solemn holy dedication with hands clasped in prayer before the sanctuary entrance, reflecting pure consecration to God.

title: Offering the Bread of God
image_prompt: Holy Place interior: High Priest standing in wholeness and dignity before the golden table, presenting fresh loaves of the bread of God before the embroidered veil, illuminated by the warm golden glow of the Menorah.

title: The Offering Without Blemish
image_prompt: Courtyard gate: a faithful Hebrew shepherd presenting an unblemished, strong, spotless white lamb with healthy wool before an examining Levite priest under morning sunlight, symbolizing integrity and wholehearted devotion in worship.

title: The Voluntary Offering of Thanksgiving
image_prompt: Sunset at the bronze altar: a grateful Hebrew family, fully and modestly robed in colorful travel mantles, watching with joyful smiles as sweet fragrant white smoke from their voluntary thanksgiving offering ascends peacefully into the evening sky.

title: The Feast of Firstfruits
image_prompt: First morning of the harvest: High Priest Aaron standing atop the sanctuary terrace lifting a freshly reaped golden sheaf of green barley high above his head, waving it toward heaven in joyful thanksgiving for the earth's first harvest.

title: The Feast of Weeks and Pentecost Loaves
image_prompt: Summer festival scene: Levite priests presenting two large golden-brown baked wheat loaves on a silver platter before the altar; background showing generous Hebrew reapers leaving the corners of the golden wheat field for poor gleaners.

title: The Feast of Trumpets
image_prompt: First day of the seventh month at sunrise: white-robed priests standing on the raised stone terrace of the Tabernacle blowing curved ram's horn shofars toward the four winds, the solemn trumpet blast calling the vast camp of Israel to holy assembly.

title: The Feast of Tabernacles in Booths
image_prompt: Bustling joyful festival: Hebrew families resting inside green leafy outdoor booths constructed of fresh palm branches, thick boughs of leafy trees, and willow branches, children waving branches of myrtle in celebration under bright autumn skies.

title: The Continual Light of the Menorah
image_prompt: Atmospheric Holy Place: High Priest Aaron gently trimming the golden wicks and pouring pure beaten olive oil into the lamps of the six-branched Menorah, ensuring the golden flames burn brightly and continually before the veil.

title: The Twelve Loaves of Shewbread
image_prompt: Close reverent perspective: the pure gold Table of Shewbread holding twelve stacked unleavened cakes arranged neatly in two rows of six, topped with golden cruets of pure white frankincense, symbolizing the twelve tribes before the Lord.

title: The Assembly of Sacred Justice
image_prompt: Outer boundary of the camp: Moses and the venerable elders of Israel seated in solemn dignified council, upholding divine righteousness and equal justice for both the native-born and the stranger under an open sky.

title: The Sabbatical Year of Land Rest
image_prompt: Lush hillside in Canaan: vineyards and wheat fields resting untouched and untilled, rich grapes and wild barley growing freely under gentle rains, with peaceful sheep grazing freely during the sacred land's Sabbath rest.

title: Proclaiming the Year of Jubilee
image_prompt: Grand panoramic scene on the Day of Atonement: a priest sounding the great silver jubilee trumpet throughout the hills, as separated families embrace in joyous tears, debts cancelled, returning freely to their ancestral inheritances in liberty.

title: Redemption by the Kinsman-Redeemer
image_prompt: Village stone courtyard: a compassionate Hebrew kinsman-redeemer in noble robes handing bright silver shekels of redemption to a landowner, joyfully restoring the deed of ancestral land to a poor smiling relative.

title: Sheltering the Impoverished Brother
image_prompt: Warm evening scene outside a tent: a generous Hebrew family welcoming a weary impoverished brother into their home, offering him a seat, a clean warm wool mantle, and bread without charging interest or usury.

title: Blessings of Peace and Abundance
image_prompt: Breathtaking agrarian paradise: fertile orchards overflowing with ripe pomegranates and figs, golden wheat swaying in gentle breezes, gentle rain clouds on the horizon, and peaceful families walking without fear under divine protection.

title: I Will Walk Among You
image_prompt: Majestic sunset view: the glorious radiant Shekinah Cloud dwelling serenely above the golden Tabernacle in the center of the camp, casting a warm golden light over the upright, freed people of Israel walking in dignity.

title: Remembering the Ancient Covenant
image_prompt: Solitary desert plateau at twilight: a humble believer kneeling in quiet prayer with arms outstretched, as heavenly rays break through evening clouds, symbolizing God's faithfulness in remembering His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

title: Consecrating Gifts to the Sanctuary
image_prompt: Courtyard treasury: devout Hebrew worshipers presenting voluntary dedicated gifts—silver vessels, acacia furniture, and woven fabrics—into the care of Levite priests with joyful and generous hearts.

title: The Holy Tithe of the Land
image_prompt: Harvest threshing floor: a faithful farmer setting aside baskets overflowing with choice grapes, golden olive oil jars, and bundles of wheat as the sacred tenth holy unto the Lord under brilliant blue skies.

title: Passing Under the Shepherd's Rod
image_prompt: Rustic stone sheepfold at sunset: a gentle Hebrew shepherd holding a wooden staff counting his white sheep as they pass through the narrow gate, marking every tenth lamb as consecrated and holy unto the Lord.
